primary_endpoint: Improvement by at least 2 points in histology (NAS) at 48–50 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint events: 5 participants with silymarin 420 mg, 4 with silymarin 700 mg, and 3 with placebo. No statistical comparison is reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs affected 1/26 participants with silymarin 420 mg, 2/27 with silymarin 700 mg, and 1/25 with placebo; deaths not reported.
